summary.text: Ron Taylor represents Idaho Senate District 26, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which says Taylor lives in Hailey.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Taylor was born in Salt Lake City, graduated from Olympus High School, and attended the University of Utah, paramedic school and a fire academy.
It says Taylor served 27 years as a firefighter and paramedic with Wood River Fire & Rescue and the Ketchum Fire Department, and one year on the Blaine County Planning and Zoning Commission.
